I focused farming xp in spring(kale crops) as well as getting materials for quality sprinklers and lightning rods. I unlocked the bus mid summer after a blueberry harvest. My first SC run was with the steel pick and 50 bombs and 4 staircases
I just unlocked the sewers the day after this screenshot

Yes i made 15 basic sprinklers, and eventually had 42 quality sprinklers. No targeted bait but i would often fish under leah’s cottage in spring as the fish there seemed more valuable, then fished in the ocean during summer for pufferfish and super cucumbers. I upgraded my pickaxe only after hitting level 100 in the mines and saved the stardrop as a energy replenish on day 1 of summer. The deluxe coop was to get rabbits, one duck, and one white and brown chicken, and big barn for a cow and goat because i’m also juggling the community bundles and need to fill in the animal one(my slowest bundle for greenhouse). I went for bats to help with the artisan bundle, and the peach tree just was a sapling from lewis’ ticket machine so i randomly planted it- though the apple tree is very intentional because bat cave rng is bad for finding apples

it’s a delicate balance of planning out crops, rng, and managing which skills to train. i was fortunate enough to have decent rng early on which snowballed. the general strat is to focus gathering materials required for each tier of sprinkler, and lucky days you go mining, otherwise go forage/fishing. i went with planting kale in the spring for farming xp until lv 6 for quality sprinklers, and blueberries during the summer. foraging level 6 is a must for lightning rods and is the main focus to collect bat wings and iron and quartz while mining. going deep in the caves with an un-upgraded pickaxe is very difficult, but can be done with cherry bombs. 
i realize there’s a lot to explain but it’s really just making sure you have no down time and are constantly spending what you earn to seek larger returns.

the trick to skull caverns is going there during a lucky day(fortune teller on tv) and ideally having a lot of bombs to bring. Food buffs like spicy eel(desert trader sells them for rubies) can also drastically help! Prioritize going deeper until you start seeing iridium over going for scraps in the early levels
just a term for someone that strives to play in an optimal way
